title: Warner Music settles copyright lawsuit with Udio, signs deal for AI music platform
description: The subscription service will allow users to make remixes, covers, and new songs using the voices of artists and compositions of songwriters who choose to participate.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Amazon’s Prime Video is getting AI-generated Video Recaps for some TV shows
description: According to Amazon, the feature "utilizes generative AI to create theatrical-quality season recaps with synchronized narration, dialogue, and music."
author: Amanda Silberling

title: YC-backed Poly relaunches as a cloud-hosted file storage with AI search
description: Poly's cloud-based file storage system with AI-powered search lets you search through text, images, audio, and video.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Adobe to buy Semrush for $1.9 billion
description: Adobe said it would offer $12 per share for Semrush, almost double the latter's closing price of $6.89 on Tuesday, before news of the deal.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Target joins OpenAI’s growing list of retail apps
description: OpenAI is pushing deeper into retail, with Target set to debut a new ChatGPT-powered app for shoppers. The app is launching in beta next week.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI board member Larry Summers steps down amid Epstein file revelations
description: Former Treasury Secretary Larry Summers has resigned from OpenAI’s board days after Congress released documents showing he was close friends with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: As Lovable hits $200M ARR, its CEO credits staying in Europe for its success
description: Lovable CEO Anton Osika said he credits ignoring advice to move to Silicon Valley for the AI coding company's success.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: TikTok will let you choose how much AI-generated content you want to see
description: With the new AI-generated content control, users who want to see less of this sort of content can dial things down, while those who enjoy it can choose to see more of it.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Hugging Face CEO says we’re in an ‘LLM bubble,’ not an AI bubble
description: Hugging Face co-founder and CEO Clem Delangue says all the attention is on LLMs, but smaller, specialized models will make sense in many use cases going forward.
author: Sarah Perez

title: AI data center provider Lambda raises whopping $1.5B after multibillion-dollar Microsoft deal
description: Lambda's new raise was a solid beat over the amount that deal-watchers say it was hoping to hit.
author: Julie Bort

title: Poe’s AI app now supports group chats across AI models
description: Quora's AI platform Poe now lets users engage in group chats with up to 200 people across AI models and bots.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Google launches Gemini 3 with new coding app and record benchmark scores
description: Google released Gemini 3, its latest and most advanced foundation model, to be made immediately available through the Gemini app and AI search interface.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Stack Overflow is remaking itself into an AI data provider
description: Stack Overflow wants to remake its classic problem-solving forum into a tool for translating human expertise into an AI-accessible format.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Intuit signs $100M+ deal with OpenAI to bring its apps to ChatGPT
description: Intuit said its tools, such as TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks and Mailchimp, will be accessible through ChatGPT, allowing users to ask questions and complete tasks such as estimating tax refunds, reviewing credit options, or managing business finances.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Databricks reportedly in talks to raise funding at a $130B+ valuation
description: Databricks is said to be in talks to raise a new round of funding just a few months after its last fundraise, which valued the company at $100 billion.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: As consumers ditch Google for ChatGPT, Peec AI raises $21M to help brands adapt
description: With consumers increasingly directing questions to ChatGPT, not Google, product discovery is changing — and the promise to give brands visibility and control over this fast-growing search channel has made Peec AI one of Europe's hottest startups.
author: Anna Heim

title: a16z-backed super PAC is targeting Alex Bores, sponsor of New York’s AI safety bill — he says bring it on
description: A super PAC backed by Andreessen Horowitz, OpenAI, and other tech leaders has targeted New York Assembly member Alex Bores' congressional campaign, marking its first attack against a lawmaker supporting AI regulation.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google rolls out its AI ‘Flight Deals’ tool globally, adds new travel features in Search
description: To get started, users need to describe where, when, and how they want to travel. Flight Deals will then use AI to display the best bargains available.
author: Aisha Malik

title: PowerLattice attracts investment from ex-Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger for its power saving chiplet
description: PowerLattice, a startup founded by veteran electrical engineers from Qualcomm, NUVIA, and Intel in 2023, claims to have developed a groundbreaking approach that reduces the power needs of computer chips by more than 50%.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Jeff Bezos reportedly returns to the trenches as co-CEO of new AI startup, Project Prometheus
description: Amazon's founder Jeff Bezos seems to be getting his hands dirty once again: the billionaire is partly backing a new AI startup called Project Prometheus that has raised $6.2 billion in funding, and will take on duties as co-chief executive.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Luminal raises $5.3 million to build a better GPU code framework
description: Inference optimization startup Luminal has announced $5.3 million in a seed funding round led by Felicis Ventures, with angel investment from Paul Graham, Guillermo Rauch and Ben Porterfield.
author: Russell Brandom

title: MCP AI agent security startup Runlayer launches with 8 unicorns, $11M from Khosla’s Keith Rabois and Felicis
description: Three-time founder Andrew Berman is back with a startup that helps IT ensure business users' AI agents operate securely.
author: Julie Bort

title: Bone AI raises $12M to challenge Asia’s defense giants with AI-powered robotics
description: Bone AI, a South Korean startup, is combining AI and manufacturing to build next-gen defense robotics and challenge the region’s industry giants.
author: Kate Park

title: Sakana AI raises $135M Series B at a $2.65B valuation to continue building AI models for Japan
description: Sakana AI raised about $135M at a $2.65B post-money valuation in one of Japan’s largest fundraises this year.
author: Kate Park

title: How much of the AI data center boom will be powered by renewable energy?
description: According to a new report from the International Energy Agency, the world will spend $580 billion on data centers this year — $40 billion more than will be spent finding new oil supplies.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Leaked documents shed light into how much OpenAI pays Microsoft
description: Leaked documents reveal how much OpenAI paid Microsoft under a revenue-share agreement. They also indicate inference costs.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Databricks co-founder argues US must go open source to beat China in AI
description: VC Andy Konwinski argues that the U.S. is losing its AI research dominance to China.
author: Marina Temkin

title: ChatGPT: Everything you need to know about the AI-powered chatbot
description: A timeline of ChatGPT product updates and releases, starting with the latest, which we’ve been updating throughout the year.
author: Kyle Wiggers, Cody Corrall, Kate Park, Alyssa Stringer

title: OpenAI says it’s fixed ChatGPT’s em dash problem
description: OpenAI says users can now personalize ChatGPT to stop using the em dash in its output.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Inside Harvey: How a first-year legal associate built one of Silicon Valley’s hottest startups
description: TechCrunch spoke with Harvey's CEO and co-founder Winston Weinberg about the wild ride that he and co-founder Gabe Pereyra have been on so far.
author: Connie Loizos
